Montréal Communiqué 


16th February 1971 


SPRINGATE TO KEYNOTE 
YMCA CAMPAIGN KICKOFF 


Liberal M.N.A. George Springate will be the keynote 
speaker at the Montreal YMCA financtal campaign's opening 
dinner on Wednesday February 24th. 

The city-wide drive for a total of $400,000. will be 
held March 8th-20th. Advance canvassing is well underway. 

Mr. Springate, a member of the Y during his teens, 
is now serving his freshman term as a member of Quebec's 
National Assembly. 

His frank confrontations with controversial issues 
have made him one of the most dynamic politicians tn the 


province today. 


« 3 = 


For further information please contact 
Bill Sher. 849-5331 Ext. 742
